BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Ganglef!!
Agh! ...It's not over.
T-This is it!!\nShining liver... Agghh...!
Hey, you!
Why weren't you there while we were going to\nsee Mauez?! You deceived us?!
No way... You got it all wrong...\nNaiata ordered me to do something urgent.
This monster's shining liver is necessary to\ncreate the new holy gem, so... I was ordered to\nget it as soon as possible.
Naiata said she was in a hurry, so I had to do it\nany minute no matter what...\nThat's why I had to leave...
Ouch... It's getting worse.\nI can't move...
I'm sorry but can you deliver it to Naiata\nthe Star Wizard...?
You guys wanna go to see her, don't you?\nLooks like you've got the proof from Mauez too, so\nthat wouldn't hurt, right? Please. I beg of you.
...Hmm. Now I have no reason to be upset...\nAlright, if you insist.
...We can also see Naiata that we've been\nsearching for, so why don't we bring it to her?
Let's go!
No.
Hey, that's not funny!
Even if you don't want to, I'm going!\nSo, you must come with me!!
Or I'll snatch all of your bags and run!
Now my bags are being held hostage...\nI have no choice but to go with her...
Oh, you can do it? Thanks.\nNaiata is in Saham Crater. It's to the south of\nSofya City. I'll leave it to you...
You got a bag that contains Shining Liver!
Thanks. Please hurry... I'm counting on you.
